nodes.Name: Ldate
nodes.DocComment:
These flags define which text to prefix to each log entry generated by the [Logger].
Bits are or'ed together to control what's printed.
With the exception of the Lmsgprefix flag, there is no
control over the order they appear (the order listed here)
or the format they present (as described in the comments).
The prefix is followed by a colon only when Llongfile or Lshortfile
is specified.
For example, flags Ldate | Ltime (or LstdFlags) produce,

	2009/01/23 01:23:23 message

while flags Ldate | Ltime | Lmicroseconds | Llongfile produce,

	2009/01/23 01:23:23.123123 /a/b/c/d.go:23: message

nodes.Name: Logger
nodes.DocComment:
A Logger represents an active logging object that generates lines of
output to an [io.Writer]. Each logging operation makes a single call to
the Writer's Write method. A Logger can be used simultaneously from
multiple goroutines; it guarantees to serialize access to the Writer.

Fields.Name: prefix
Fields.DocComment: prefix on each line to identify the logger (but see Lmsgprefix)

nodes.Name: New
nodes.DocComment:
New creates a new [Logger]. The out variable sets the
destination to which log data will be written.
The prefix appears at the beginning of each generated log line, or
after the log header if the [Lmsgprefix] flag is provided.
The flag argument defines the logging properties.

nodes.Name: SetOutput
nodes.DocComment: SetOutput sets the output destination for the logger.

nodes.Name: Default
nodes.DocComment: Default returns the standard logger used by the package-level output functions.

nodes.Name: itoa
nodes.DocComment: Cheap integer to fixed-width decimal ASCII. Give a negative width to avoid zero-padding.

nodes.Name: formatHeader
nodes.DocComment:
formatHeader writes log header to buf in following order:
  - l.prefix (if it's not blank and Lmsgprefix is unset),
  - date and/or time (if corresponding flags are provided),
  - file and line number (if corresponding flags are provided),
  - l.prefix (if it's not blank and Lmsgprefix is set).

nodes.Name: Output
nodes.DocComment:
Output writes the output for a logging event. The string s contains
the text to print after the prefix specified by the flags of the
Logger. A newline is appended if the last character of s is not
already a newline. Calldepth is used to recover the PC and is
provided for generality, although at the moment on all pre-defined
paths it will be 2.

nodes.Name: output
nodes.DocComment:
output can take either a calldepth or a pc to get source line information.
It uses the pc if it is non-zero.

nodes.Name: Print
nodes.DocComment:
Print calls l.Output to print to the logger.
Arguments are handled in the manner of [fmt.Print].

nodes.Name: Printf
nodes.DocComment:
Printf calls l.Output to print to the logger.
Arguments are handled in the manner of [fmt.Printf].

nodes.Name: Println
nodes.DocComment:
Println calls l.Output to print to the logger.
Arguments are handled in the manner of [fmt.Println].

nodes.Name: Fatal
nodes.DocComment: Fatal is equivalent to l.Print() followed by a call to [os.Exit](1).

nodes.Name: Fatalf
nodes.DocComment: Fatalf is equivalent to l.Printf() followed by a call to [os.Exit](1).

nodes.Name: Fatalln
nodes.DocComment: Fatalln is equivalent to l.Println() followed by a call to [os.Exit](1).

nodes.Name: Panic
nodes.DocComment: Panic is equivalent to l.Print() followed by a call to panic().

nodes.Name: Panicf
nodes.DocComment: Panicf is equivalent to l.Printf() followed by a call to panic().

nodes.Name: Panicln
nodes.DocComment: Panicln is equivalent to l.Println() followed by a call to panic().

nodes.Name: Flags
nodes.DocComment:
Flags returns the output flags for the logger.
The flag bits are [Ldate], [Ltime], and so on.

nodes.Name: SetFlags
nodes.DocComment:
SetFlags sets the output flags for the logger.
The flag bits are [Ldate], [Ltime], and so on.

nodes.Name: Prefix
nodes.DocComment: Prefix returns the output prefix for the logger.

nodes.Name: SetPrefix
nodes.DocComment: SetPrefix sets the output prefix for the logger.

nodes.Name: Writer
nodes.DocComment: Writer returns the output destination for the logger.

nodes.Name: SetOutput
nodes.DocComment: SetOutput sets the output destination for the standard logger.

nodes.Name: Flags
nodes.DocComment:
Flags returns the output flags for the standard logger.
The flag bits are [Ldate], [Ltime], and so on.

nodes.Name: SetFlags
nodes.DocComment:
SetFlags sets the output flags for the standard logger.
The flag bits are [Ldate], [Ltime], and so on.

nodes.Name: Prefix
nodes.DocComment: Prefix returns the output prefix for the standard logger.

nodes.Name: SetPrefix
nodes.DocComment: SetPrefix sets the output prefix for the standard logger.

nodes.Name: Writer
nodes.DocComment: Writer returns the output destination for the standard logger.

nodes.Name: Print
nodes.DocComment:
Print calls Output to print to the standard logger.
Arguments are handled in the manner of [fmt.Print].

nodes.Name: Printf
nodes.DocComment:
Printf calls Output to print to the standard logger.
Arguments are handled in the manner of [fmt.Printf].

nodes.Name: Println

Println calls Output to print to the standard logger.
Arguments are handled in the manner of [fmt.Println].

nodes.DocComment: Fatalf is equivalent to [Printf] followed by a call to [os.Exit](1).

nodes.Name: Fatalln
nodes.DocComment: Fatalln is equivalent to [Println] followed by a call to [os.Exit](1).

nodes.Name: Panicf

nodes.Name: Panicln

nodes.Name: Output
nodes.DocComment:
Output writes the output for a logging event. The string s contains
the text to print after the prefix specified by the flags of the
Logger. A newline is appended if the last character of s is not
already a newline. Calldepth is the count of the number of
frames to skip when computing the file name and line number
if [Llongfile] or [Lshortfile] is set; a value of 1 will print the details
for the caller of Output.
